definition: the big white animal of the arctic ice
description: On a snowy Arctic plain at golden hour, a big white polar bear stands up on its hind legs beside a large white tundra bus with huge tyres and rests its front paws on the side under a window. Inside, a young woman in a cream knitted hat presses her hands to the glass and gasps. The bear drops down onto all four paws and walks along the bus through the snow. Other passengers look out of the windows, one covering her mouth, and a second polar bear stands in the snow in the distance.

taps.target: the woman in the cream hat
